items.summary: CRO recommends no new implementation admission this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 57 improvements are measuring, and duplicate/overlapping work is already present. After CTO releases capacity, execute only the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement against the recorded 61 Amazon-click baseline for 2026-09-21. Measure existing affiliate clicks and GA4 outcomes for 14 days or 100 relevant impressions/clicks; revenue and causal lift remain unknown. Do not add tracking, dependencies, credentials, spend, or cross-site behavior.

The proposed canonical work graph is strategically sound but must remain deferred until current repair and capacity gates clear. Evidence supports the problem: 108 approved proposals lack execution requests, 21 implementation requests failed, 57 improvements await measurement, and 10/10 delivery slots are occupied. A smallest reversible prototype would be a read-only ledger view linking one decision to one canonical request, duplicate detection, owner/stale-state visibility, failure repair path, capacity state, and measurement due state using existing fields only. Expected metric: higher approval-to-execution rate, fewer duplicate admissions and stale owned items, and fewer no-action executable cycles. Time-to-learn: one control-plane measurement window after release. Risks: control-plane regression, incorrect deduplication, stale joins, and maintenance burden; require CTO review, deterministic tests, rollback, and no changes to schedules, permissions, telemetry collection, credentials, or deployment behavior.
